reason: It is free for me, but a full renovation is far more money than I earn in a year, and the page does not say what I get back if a crew walks off mid-job. I would check the Facebook page first, and there is nothing on it yet I can check.
objection: Can the crew run over budget and I have no recourse? The mid-job stop rule is still 'to be defined', and the crew checks are still 'to be defined' too.
would_change_my_mind: A written rule for what I get back if a crew stops mid-job, plus a crew check I can look up myself before I sign anything.
